description:
Expert metrology software for effortless and rapid 3D scan data capture.

Revo Measure is a professional 3D metrology software for accurate and quick scan-to-CAD comparisons and deviation analysis for quality control, reverse engineering, and industrial design applications.
1. Adds USB security key-based software activation.
2. Adds monthly subscription support with auto-renewal.
3. Adds "Plane-Plane-Plane" alignment mode to the 3-2-1 Plane-Axis-Point alignment function.
4. Adds point feature creation mode using auxiliary objects.
5. Adds circle feature creation mode using auxiliary objects.
6. Adds free annotation positioning during cross section measurement.
7. Adds support for 12 additional CAD file formats.
8. Optimizes Pass/Fail status background colors in reports.
9. Adds custom logo support in reports.
10. Optimizes point deviation visualization.
11. Optimizes visual feedback in point-selection mode.
12. Fixes some bugs.
